annotations.title: Verify a claim against a document

description: Check one claim against a document page: {predicate, value} (anything doc_verify_facts accepts) or a short claim sentence ({text} or a bare string), plus the verbatim quote and page it rests on. Returns supported (the quote is on the page and every checked number, date and name in the claim is written in it), contradicted (the quote is on the page and states other numbers or dates of the same kind, listed in quote_states), or unverifiable (the quote is not on the page, nothing in the claim can be checked, or the quote states no value of that kind), with the evidence (document_id, page, quote, span) and each part checked. Textual, not semantic: for a sentence only its numbers and dates are compared, never its meaning, and a quote that mentions the right number for a different term still supports it.

anyOf.description: A short claim sentence, read as {text: the sentence}; its numbers and dates are checked.

predicate.description: Predicate of the claim, with value.

text.description: Or a short claim sentence instead of predicate and value; its numbers and dates are checked.

value.description: Claimed value in the predicate's shape, with predicate.

document.description: The document the quote is from.

ocr_pages.description: Optional: pages (1-based) whose text came from OCR rather than the file's text layer (doc_read_pdf and factlot.read_pdf report them). Facts and citations on these pages carry ocr: true, so a reviewer checks the scan.

pages.description: The document's text, one string per page in order: pages[0] is page 1. Send the text as extracted (from the PDF text layer or OCR), not a summary; quotes are matched against it.

items.description: The text of one page, exactly as extracted.

sha256.description: Optional SHA-256 (lowercase hex) of the original file. When given, document_id is fl:document:sha256-<this>, the same ID id_document gives the file; FactLot cannot check that the pages came from that file. Without it, document_id is the SHA-256 of the pages joined by form feeds (\f).

title.description: Document title for citations, e.g. "First Amendment to Lease".

quote.description: Verbatim text from the page that the claim rests on.

name: doc_verify_claim
title: Verify a claim against a document
